title.narrative: PROVISION OF QUALITY COMPETENCY-BASED PRIMARY AND SECONDARY EDUCATION FOR CHILDRE

description.narrative: By 2022, government agencies (central and local) and educational institutions have strengthened their capacity to provide quality, competency-based primary and secondary education for children and adolescents aged 6-18 years old and ensure inclusive, violence- free learning environment for all with special focus on children with disabilities.
